subject: Renewal: Premium SLA + Dedicated capacity uplift inquiry
messages:
From: Kyle Martin <kyle@openera.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:05-07:00
Subject: Renewal + SLA upgrade inquiry

Jonas,

Quick note as our renewal window approaches (end of May) — were evaluating upping our response guarantees and reserving additional capacity. Two asks from the product and platform teams: 

- Move from Standard support to a Premium SLA that includes a 99th percentile latency SLO and faster triage times for escalations.
- Reserve a dedicated pool (roughly 2x our current committed GPUs) for predictable throughput during peak ML experiments.

Attached: growth_forecast_q3.xlsx (capacity forecast).

Can you send a short runbook of what the Premium SLA covers and an estimate for committed pricing? Also loop in whoever owns ops/implementations so we can validate the migration runbook.

Thanks,
Kyle Martin
Head of Platform | Openera

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Martin <kyle@openera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T10:05:18-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SLA upgrade inquiry

Kyle — appreciate the heads up and the forecast. Quick summary and suggested path: 

1) Premium SLA overview (attached): Redwood-Premium-SLA-terms-v1.pdf. High level: 99th percentile latency SLOs for text gen endpoints, 30-minute P1 response target for escalations, monthly quality regressions monitoring, and quarterly performance reviews.

2) Dedicated reserve: we can provision a reserved GPU pool sized to your forecast. For a 2x uplift were estimating a committed monthly fee + usage tapering. Ive asked Marissa to prepare a quote.

3) Ops/onboarding: Evelyn will own the runbook and staging migration; Dev will own model pinning and rollout configuration. Proposal: mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones — Agreement, PO, SOC2/RPO checks, staging cutover, go-live. Ill attach a simple MAP CSV you can use. 

Next steps: Marissa will share a firm quote and a DocuSign for signature. Can your procurement and legal review the SLA PDF and the quote in parallel?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Premium-SLA-terms-v1.pdf

From: Kyle Martin <kyle@openera.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nina Gomez <procurement@openera.com>, legal@openera.com
Date: 2027-04-04T14:31:22-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SLA upgrade inquiry

Thanks Jonas — this looks promising. A few clarifying points from our side: 

- Wed like the dedicated pool approach to avoid noisy-neighbor tail latency; estimate still stands at 2x current commit.
- Confirm that the Premium SLA includes automatic fallback to a compatible open model variant (same family) in case of capacity shortages. That fallback must be logged and auditable.
- Procurement will need a line-item quote and expected start date for the commit.

Looping Nina from procurement and our legal contact.

-Kyle

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Gomez <procurement@openera.com>, Kyle Martin <kyle@openera.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-05T11:20:09-07:00
Subject: OP-987654 quote: Dedicated reserve + Premium SLA (draft)

Hi Nina / Kyle,

Attached is a draft quote for the 12-month committed Dedicated Reserve + Premium SLA: quote_OP-987654.pdf. Highlights: 

- Committed reserved capacity: 2x baseline (monthly billing cadence)
- Premium SLA add-on: entitlement to 99th percentile latency SLO, 30-min P1 response, and two quarterly performance reviews
- One-time onboarding fee covers staging, model pinning, and KV cache priming

Please review the line items and confirm whether Openera needs an alternative billing cadence (quarterly vs monthly). Once you confirm, well generate the DocuSign envelope and route to legal.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/OP-987654

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: quote_OP-987654.pdf

From: Nina Gomez <procurement@openera.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kyle Martin <kyle@openera.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, legal@openera.com
Date: 2027-04-07T09:00:05-07:00
Subject: Openera redlines and data residency question

Marissa, Jonas — thanks for the quick response and the quote. Our legal team has a few redlines; Im attaching the changes (Openera_Redlines.docx). Key asks from procurement/legal: 

- Data residency: confirm logs and audit artifacts will be retained in the US region only for this committed instance.
- Fallback transparency: we need an automated alerting line item when fallback happens (so we can adjust model routing).
- Warranties & liability: request a small amendment on the SLA credits calculation to reflect our enterprise procurement policy.

Can you confirm timeline for redline review and whether Redwood can accept the suggested data residency clause? We are targeting a signed agreement by 2027-04-20 to align with internal budget cycles.

Thanks,
Nina Gomez
VP Procurement | Openera

Attachment: Openera_Redlines.docx

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Gomez <procurement@openera.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kyle Martin <kyle@openera.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, legal@openera.com
Date: 2027-04-07T16:45:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Openera redlines and data residency question

Nina — thanks for the clear redlines. Quick answers inline and next steps: 

- Data residency: we can stand up the Dedicated Reserve in the US region and retain logs/audit artifacts in your tenant that are US-located. Ive linked our SOC2 report here: https://redwood.example.com/reports/soc2-report-2026.pdf. Evelyn will confirm data export/retention retention policies in the MAP.
- Fallback transparency: we can add an automated alert route (Slack + email) that fires on fallback and a daily fallback report during the first 30 days post-cutover. That will be added as an SLA appendix.
- SLA credits formula: Marissa, legal team to review Ninas suggested language; if acceptable we can incorporate a minor amendment in the DocuSign envelope.

Timeline: 
- 2027-04-08: Redwood legal to review Openera_Redlines.docx and propose clean language
- 2027-04-12: Final quote + DocuSign envelope circulated
- 2027-04-20: Target signature 

Ive attached a simple mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan.csv) with milestones and owners to keep the runbook tidy. Let us know if the target dates are workable.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.csv
